headline: Cisco is adding Dialog, a toolset for AI agents that handle customer work on its Webex platform.
score_reason: Pool 5, kept: an enterprise product announced 7 Oct.
importance_line: It matters to businesses that run customer service on Webex and to the customers who talk to those agents, but Engadget notes that AI agents still fail often on multi-step tasks and the safety claims are Cisco's own.
summary: Engadget reports that Cisco is updating its Webex business platform with Dialog, a control layer that directs AI agents to handle customer work, and that these agents keep working after a conversation ends. Anyone in a Webex workspace can invite agents into meetings and calls, and Cisco says its Splunk data tools, from Splunk, a data analysis company Cisco owns, support a safety-first approach.
